key_insight: FoG trains knowledge-graph agents to retrieve supporting triples, making answers traceable rather than merely correct.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-aware training can help engineers build auditable question-answering systems that expose the facts behind their outputs.
method: Synthesize evidence-grounded questions by recursively replacing explicit entities with verifiable sub-questions.
Record the triples returned during the agent’s knowledge-graph interactions.
Use an evidence-coverage process reward to credit each supporting triple to the turn that first retrieves it.
evidence_signal: Across three KGQA benchmarks, the abstract reports that 3B–4B open-source agents outperform substantially larger baselines in answer accuracy and evidence coverage, with zero-shot cross-KG transfer.
watch_item: Evidence coverage measures retrieval of supporting triples, but does not by itself establish that the agent faithfully uses them to derive its answer.
paper_title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
